era: Bulbapedia 2019 in its MonoBook skin (Arquivo.pt captures of the Main Page Apr, Sep and Dec 2019 and Pokémon articles Jun-Sep 2019): white content box on the green frame with the Bulbapedia logo top left, tabs (page, discussion, view source, history), personal tools at the top right, left sidebar portlets (navigation with Editor's Hub, FAQ, Bulbawiki forum, Recent changes, Random page; search; Bulbagarden links with Archives, Forums, Discord, Twitch, YouTube, Handbooks; Social media with Facebook, Twitter, Tumblr; toolbox; In other languages), Main Page boxes and the footer with the licence and Copyrights. The live site is behind Cloudflare, so the inventory was taken read-only in the user's Chrome with the inventory collector; net19 loads it with useskin=monobook.
